bundle.shortDescription: A desktop window for coding CLIs: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Ollama and more.
bundle.longDescription: ezCLI runs coding command line tools such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Ollama and Freebuff in a native window. Each session is a real pseudo-terminal, so the agent's own text UI renders unchanged. The app never calls a model itself, so running it costs nothing beyond what the CLIs already use.
